thread:
joel: Headline from the A/B vs v9.0 (staged 15%): global concordance delta = -0.35% (n=9.2k). latency p50 ~48ms p95 ~210ms. cost ~=0.38x baseline.
tara: OK. any problematic slices?
joel: dialog-coherence slice shows -1.4% (n=950) with CI [-2.6%,-0.2%], p=0.07. long-instr slice -1.0% (n=1.3k), p=0.04.
frank: dialog-coherence under the absolute slice_threshold (-1.5%) so technically not crossed, but CI and p-value are messy because sample count < min_samples (1000). how does the canary policy handle this?
gate-bot: Policy lookup: canary.policy.v2 -> slice_threshold=-0.015, global_threshold=-0.008, min_samples=1000, require_pvalue<0.05, conservative_mode=false.
tara: thanks. so dialog-coherence misses min_samples by 50. p=0.07 so no auto-fallback. but CI lower bound crosses -1.5 making it borderline.
joel: noticed variance inflation on that slice: sample variance doubled vs baseline -> p-value unstable. possible collection skew: cohort had more short-turns removed by prefilter.
frank: two options: 1) let it ride (15% exposure) 2) drain to 0 immediately 3) soft-pin to 5% while we run stratified 3k targeted eval for dialog-coherence. my vote: soft-pin + focused eval.
tara: agree. soft-pin reduces blast radius and buys time to diagnose variance cause. also add a preflight check to confirm min_samples for critical slices before any promotion step.
joel: executing: /route soft-pin --model v9.1-q4 --pct 5 --decay 2h --note "dialog-coherence borderline; soft-pin to limit exposure and run stratified eval"
gate-bot: Command acknowledged. Soft-pin applied: routing 5% -> v9.1-q4 (decay window 2h). Monitoring alert threshold lowered for pinned routes.
frank: starting targeted stratified run now: n=3k dialog-coherence heavy, seeded from failing buckets. will post artifacts.
tara: also add a short-term override to canary.policy: if sample_count<min_samples but CI lower bound <= slice_threshold and p<0.1 and traffic_weight>0.1 -> trigger a soft-rollback recommendation to humans. add to runbook.
gate-bot: Noted: proposal logged as CHG-2026-221.
joel: artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/1775551233/v9.1q4-softpin-smoke.jsonl. quick perf traces uploaded to https://redwood.internal/evals/1775551233
frank: early stratified run bootstrapping in progress. if stratified run confirms delta > -1.5 with p<0.05 we'll rollback; if not, we can lift pin after 24h shadow.
tara: one more ask: capture the per-host sampler rates and prefilter pass rates for the dialog-coherence bucket; we suspect sampling mismatch biased that slice.
joel: will grab those logs and attach to the ticket. incident INC-2026-0777 created for soft-pin investigation. assigned: joel, frank. SLA: 48h.
frank: also toggling an internal flag to force identical sampling between baseline and canary for the next run.
tara: good. keep thread updated with the stratified run artifact id and final decision. :eyes:
